description: Details submitted pursuant to Condition 7 (external lighting) in accordance with planning application 00550/AQ(U1)/P1 dated 23 March 2011 for the erection of seven B1(c)/B2/B8 units with ancillary offices totalling 2790 sq.m. and erection of 4580 sq.m of warehouse space (B8) with ancillary offices to be erected in two phases, phase 1 dividing the Details of flood lighting required by condition 7 of planning permission 00550/AQ(U1)/P1 dated 23/03/2011 for the erection of seven B1(c)/B2/B8 units with ancillary offices totalling 2790 sq.m. and erection of 4580 sq.m of warehouse space (B8) with ancillary offices to be erected in two phases, phase 1 dividing the space into 3810 sq.m of warehouse and 770 sq.m of covered loading and storage and phase 2 enclosing entire unit as a warehouse.
